_comment: Bundled Sigma vocabulary registry — see PLAN-IMPL-SIGMA-HUMANIZE-OPERATION-20260816 §2.6/§2.10. Copied into every project's Sigma/rules/ via `sigma project start`/`sigma project sync`, same as ARC-RULE.md etc. Do not edit per-project — edit the source at Sigma/rules/sigma_terminology.default.json in the sigma-ecosystem repo and re-run `sigma setup update`. For project-specific additions, use Sigma/sigma_terminology.custom.json instead (never overwritten by sync).
